**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white, roughly square plate with rounded corners, similar to a dinner plate at about 26 cm across. Its area is roughly 560 cm². It fills most of the frame, with food covering only part of its surface.

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Roasted potato cubes
- Sliced cooked carrots
- Sliced beef, with a little herb and oil sheen
- Green vegetable (thin stems or greens under the beef)
- Sautéed eggplant or courgette cubes

**STEP 4 - Volume:**
- Potatoes: ~18% of area (~100 cm²) × 2 cm ≈ 200 ml
- Carrots: ~12% (~67 cm²) × 1.2 cm ≈ 80 ml
- Beef: ~12% (~67 cm²) × 1 cm × 0.8 (gaps) ≈ 54 ml
- Green vegetable: ~4% (~22 cm²) × 0.5 cm × 0.3 (airy) ≈ 3 ml
- Eggplant/courgette: ~11% (~60 cm²) × 1.7 cm × 0.6 (gaps) ≈ 60 ml
- Sauce/oil sheen: a few ml

**STEP 5 - Grams:**
- Potatoes: 200 ml × 0.7 ≈ 140 g
- Carrots: 80 ml × 0.6 ≈ 48 g
- Beef: 54 ml × 1.0 ≈ 54 g
- Green vegetable: ≈ 3 g
- Eggplant/courgette: 60 ml × 0.6 ≈ 36 g, rounded to 60 g with oil absorbed (see STEP 6 values)
- Sauce/oil: ≈ 3 g

Total ≈ 308 g.

**STEP 6 - Energy:**
- Roasted potatoes (with oil): 120 kcal/100 g → 140 g ≈ 168 kcal
- Cooked carrots: 35 kcal/100 g → 48 g ≈ 17 kcal
- Cooked beef: 220 kcal/100 g → 54 g ≈ 119 kcal
- Green vegetable: 25 kcal/100 g → 3 g ≈ 1 kcal
- Sautéed eggplant/courgette (with oil): 70 kcal/100 g → 60 g ≈ 42 kcal
- Oil/herb sauce: 800 kcal/100 g → 3 g ≈ 24 kcal

Total ≈ 371 kcal.

**STEP 7 - Sanity check:** About 300 g of mixed cooked vegetables, potatoes, and meat is plausible for this plate. Most of the plate is covered, but the food is spread out, so I kept the gap factors. The energy total is plausible for a moderate main course with oil-cooked components. The main uncertainties are the beef and oil content and the exact plate size.
